findings.highlight: taken to a place like this
findings.evidenceJa: このような場所に監禁される
findings.governingReading: Saber rebukes Shirou for being easily abducted by Illya and confined in a place like this.
findings.explanation: Taken to omits his imprisonment, weakening the basis of Saber’s anger.

findings.evidenceJa: 出向く必要もなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin says perhaps there was no need for them to come all this way.
findings.explanation: The infinitive marker is missing, producing an overt grammar error.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけは生き延びる
findings.governingReading: Archer says this kind of man burdens everyone around him yet alone manages to survive.
findings.explanation: The English omits だけ and loses the barb that Shirou survives while others bear the cost.

findings.highlight: went out intending to kill them
findings.evidenceJa: 殺す、と宣言して出ていった
findings.governingReading: Illya left after explicitly declaring that she would kill Rin and Archer.
findings.explanation: Intending removes the spoken declaration on which Shirou bases his inference.

findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts with relief that Rin and Illya apparently missed one another.
findings.explanation: That’s okay expresses acceptance rather than relief at avoiding the fight.

findings.highlight: wouldn’t have come in like this
findings.evidenceJa: こんなところまで忍び込まない
findings.governingReading: Rin says they would not have infiltrated this far into the castle without confirming Illya and Berserker had left.
findings.explanation: Come in omits the stealth and depth of the infiltration.

findings.governingReading: Shirou regards Rin as characteristically bold or aggressive, and this time her nerve proved fortunate.
findings.explanation: Direct changes risk-taking boldness into communicative straightforwardness.

findings.highlight: only Saber knew where you were
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーじゃないとアンタの居場所は判らなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin could not have determined Shirou’s location without Saber.
findings.explanation: Only Saber knew implies she already possessed the location, obscuring her role as the means of tracking him.

findings.governingReading: Shirou moves his injured body with desperate effort.
findings.explanation: Earnestly is nonidiomatic for physical exertion and weakens the severity of the effort.

findings.evidenceJa: もっと日数が経っていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether more days, rather than merely half a day, may have passed.
findings.explanation: Longer leaves the unit unspecified and loses his fear that multiple days elapsed.

findings.governingReading: Although only half a day has elapsed, Saber says that because the date changed it counts formally as a whole day of captivity.
findings.explanation: Captured for a day now converts the calendar-form distinction into elapsed duration and contradicts the preceding sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 捕まえた昆虫を串刺しにする
findings.governingReading: Her smile exposes the innocent, merciless impulse of a child impaling an insect she has caught.
findings.explanation: Kill generalizes the act and removes the concrete impalement image that defines Illya’s cruelty.

findings.governingReading: Berserker’s repositioning places the escape party in checkmate.
findings.explanation: Done for conveys doom but removes the tactical checkmate metaphor; “now” also risks sounding temporary.

findings.evidenceJa: 無駄死にと知りながらも
findings.governingReading: Their only remaining path is to challenge the mass of death despite knowing they will die in vain.
findings.explanation: Pointless omits the explicit death that makes the choice more than a futile attempt.

findings.evidenceJa: 理性を一時的に解放され
findings.governingReading: Illya temporarily releases Berserker’s reason so that he consciously recognizes the enemies before him.
findings.explanation: The English omits the temporary limit and leaves the degree and duration of his restored reason unbounded.

findings.governingReading: Archer voices an outrageous proposition: that he may defeat Berserker rather than merely delay him.
findings.explanation: Unexpected removes the judgment that the claim is wildly beyond reason in this situation.
